premises.text: Health tracking can empower individuals to take control of their health.
premises.evidence_span: our passion is empowering you to take control of your health.

premises.text: Dyno can track 33 different health metrics.
premises.evidence_span: It's able to track 33 different health metrics.

premises.text: The device can communicate with mobile devices via Bluetooth or a 3G Wi-Fi sanitizing cradle.
premises.evidence_span: It can communicate to any mobile device via Bluetooth or it can also talk to a 3G Wi-Fi sanitizing cradle.

premises.text: The technology can identify health abnormalities.
premises.evidence_span: our analytic software was able to identify and alert the facility of two abnormalities.

premises.text: Tracking health metrics can improve the quality of care for the aging population.
premises.evidence_span: Having the ability to track their health has dramatic implication on the quality of the care they're going to receive.

premises.text: There is a significant market for remote health monitoring.
premises.evidence_span: there are now 17 states that pay for remote monitoring.

premises.text: The venture can generate revenue through subscriptions, OEM, and licensing.
premises.evidence_span: How do we make money? Through subscription base, OEM and licensing revenue.

value.text: Individuals can better understand and control their health through advanced tracking technology.
value.evidence_span: as more individuals want to be empowered to better understand and control their own health.

notes: Clinical pilot results and specific cost savings are excluded as they do not represent premises.
